name: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV Unit
summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company's efforts to identify a target business will not be limited to a particular industry or geographic region. The company is led by Jonathan Boyer, Michael Dillard and Dr. Young Kwon and based out of New York, NY.
